caseNameFull: In the Matter of Ramon King QUICHOCHO, Jr.

opinions.text: Ramon King Quichocho, Jr., of Spanaway, Washington, having requested to resign as a member of the Bar of this Court, it is ordered that his name be stricken *474from the roll of attorneys admitted to the practice of law before this Court. The Rule to Show Cause, issued on August 29, 2014, is discharged.
